[ TOOLS.05 ] - Utility

EXIF
Viewer & Stripper

Drop a photo and see what it carries beyond the image: GPS coordinates, camera make and serial, capture times, software, and orientation. Then download a copy with the metadata stripped. JPEG, PNG, WebP, and HEIC/HEIF files are read locally and never uploaded.

// Expected Output

Formats JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC/HEIF
Reads EXIF, GPS, XMP, IPTC blocks
Strip Lossless, no re-encode
Server calls Zero, runs locally
Offline support Yes, download the .html

Part of a growing toolkit built with the same logic as every client project: fast, focused, and free.
